blocks.text: Dork ducked back into the driver’s compartment.
His hand went toward the firing control.
blocks.alt: Dork reaches toward the firing control while Zerdo grips the crooked turret’s damaged lower rim.

blocks.text: Seth got both hands under the crooked turret’s rim.
“Jenny. Clear.”
She stepped away from the tracks.
Dork’s fingers closed over the control.
Seth pulled.
Bolts cracked around the turret ring. Steel shrieked.
The whole assembly came up in his hands.
blocks.alt: Zerdo tears the complete turret clear of the tank, with its copper emitter attached and its firing cable disconnected.

blocks.text: A black cable stretched beneath it, pulled out of its socket and dangled loose. Dork jabbed the control. The copper opening stayed dark.
Dork looked up through the empty ring.
Seth shifted the weight away from the driver’s opening. His boots ground against the pavement.
“Your gun’s come loose,” he said.
Above the rooftops, Fist heard the tearing metal.
He glanced down.
Jaws lunged.
Fist rolled hard. Iron teeth clapped shut behind his white cuff.
blocks.alt: Fist rolls away as Jaws snaps his metal teeth just behind the repaired white cuff.

blocks.text: “Keep looking away,” Jaws said.
Fist swung around to face him.
“Keep missing.”
Below, Dork grabbed a driving lever.
Jenny reached the driver’s opening before he could pull it.
Her white glove closed around his wrist.
“Out.”
He snatched his other hand toward the controls. She caught that one too.
Seth held the turret well to the side while Jenny hauled Dork through the lower hatch and onto the street.
blocks.alt: Jenny pulls Dork from the lower hull driver opening while Zerdo holds the detached turret safely aside.

blocks.text: His shoes scraped the armor.
“Do you know what that cost?”
Jenny kept hold of him.
“You stole it.”
Dork twisted toward the tank.
Jenny turned him back.
Billy waved two officers around the stone planter.
“This way. Keep behind the planter when you take him out.”
An officer fastened cuffs behind Dork’s back. The other took his arm.
blocks.alt: Billy directs two officers as they take the struggling Dork into custody behind a stone planter.

blocks.text: Dork craned his neck toward the turret.
“Put that down!”
Seth bent his knees.
“I was going to.”
He lowered the assembly onto clear pavement, copper opening pointed away from the officers.
Jenny crouched beside its open underside.
The ray’s metal box sat in a bolted cradle. Its broken control lead hung beside the turret ring.
“Tool rack,” Seth said, nodding toward the hull.
Jenny fetched a wrench from the clips beside the driver’s seat. While Seth steadied the steel shell, she loosened the cradle’s retaining nuts.
The last bracket swung free.
She drew the box backward. The short copper rings slid out of the turret’s front plate with it.
blocks.alt: Jenny releases the ray’s mounting inside the detached turret while Zerdo steadies it on the street.

blocks.text: One empty round opening remained.
Jaws saw the police car below.
Laura was still beside its open rear door.
He broke away from Fist and dived.
blocks.alt: Jaws dives toward Laura’s police cruiser with Fist pursuing from above.

blocks.text: “Laura!”
Her escort looked up. The officer with the extinguisher moved with him, keeping Laura behind the open door.
Jaws opened his teeth.
Laura stepped back.
“Don’t hit the car!”
Fist cut across the dive.
His knuckles struck the side of the iron jaw.
blocks.alt: Fist punches Jaws sideways away from the police cruiser and Laura’s escort.

blocks.text: Jaws flew sideways into the cleared square, well away from the car. He caught himself above the pavement and whirled back.
Fist stayed between him and the officers.
“You’ll have to get past me.”
Laura stared after them, furious. She stayed with her escort.
Jenny put the ray into Billy’s waiting hands.
“Keep it pointed down. Don’t touch the controls.”
Billy carried it behind the planter. An officer stayed beside him.
Jenny checked the driver’s compartment. Empty.
A heavy towing chain hung in clips along the hull. She unhooked it and laid it on the curb, out of Seth’s way.
Then she looked along the street. Dork and the officers were clear. So were Laura and her escort.
She raised her hand to Seth.
blocks.alt: Billy carries the disconnected ray behind cover as Jenny checks the empty hull and signals Zerdo.

blocks.text: “All yours.”
Seth took hold of the turret again.
This time there was no copper barrel in its front. No machine inside it. Just steel.
He lifted it high.
blocks.alt: Zerdo raises the empty turret shell overhead, with its front emitter opening visibly empty.

blocks.text: Behind the planter, Dork stopped struggling.
“No! That’s an Army tank!”
Seth looked at the empty hull.
“I know.”
He brought the turret down.
blocks.alt: Zerdo smashes the empty turret shell across the vacant hull, folding armor and buckling the tracks.

blocks.text: The crash rolled between the buildings.
The hull folded beneath the blow. A track snapped loose and spilled across the pavement. The other buckled under the tank’s weight.
Dust burst around Seth’s boots.
He let the turret settle into the crushed armor and stepped back.
The engine coughed once.
Then it stopped.
Jaws turned at the crash.
He saw Dork behind the planter. The empty circle where the turret had been. The heap of steel below it.
His eyes went back to Fist.
He charged with his teeth wide open.
blocks.alt: Jaws charges Fist above the wrecked tank while the glove waits and begins a last-second dodge.

blocks.text: Fist held his place.
Closer.
The white cuff twitched.
Jaws snapped at it.
Fist dropped beneath the bite and drove upward.
His knuckles caught the iron jaw.
Jaws hit the clear pavement beside the wreck and skidded to a stop.
blocks.alt: Jaws lies dazed on clear pavement beside the wreck while Fist guards him and Jenny approaches.

blocks.text: For a moment, his eyes would not quite focus.
Fist hovered above him, cuff safely out of reach.
Jenny arrived with the towing chain.
“Keep him there.”
Before Jaws could open his teeth, she passed the chain around the closed metal jaw. Seth came beside her and pulled it snug against the iron side plates, leaving Jaws’s nose and eyes clear.
They fastened the short tether to the tank’s undamaged rear towing eye.
Jaws tried to rise. The chain drew tight.
He tried his teeth. The links held the metal halves together.
Seth kept a hand on the chain. Fist did not move away.
An officer called for equipment to move him under guard.
Across the street, Laura watched Jenny return to her escort.
“Still want me on your team?”
Jenny glanced at the wreck, then back at her.
“If you want to help.”
Laura looked away. She gave no answer.
The officer with the extinguisher stayed nearby while his partner radioed for supervised transport. Nobody hurried her into an unguarded car.
Behind the planter, Billy set the ray down carefully beside the officer. Dork sat between his guards, glaring at the tank.
Fist watched Jaws. Seth held the tether.
Above them, every window of Terminal Tower caught the afternoon light.
blocks.alt: The Defenders hold the cleared square around the wrecked tank, secured ray and guarded villains beneath intact Terminal Tower.

blocks.text: Seth looked up.
Still there.
